mods.name: Auto Mending
mods.description:
Automatically uses your experience to repair items with the Mending enchantment, including items inside shulker boxes.
不再需要手动捡经验球，系统会自动消耗经验值修复带有经验修补附魔的物品，包括潜影盒内的物品。

releases.notes:
## Downloads

| File | Game Version | Loader |
| --- | --- | --- |
| auto-mending-1.20.1-1.0.2.jar | Minecraft 1.20.1 | Forge |
| auto-mending-1.19.2-1.0.2.jar | Minecraft 1.19.2 | Forge |
| auto-mending-1.21.1-1.0.2.jar | Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge |

Each jar is compiled for its matching game version. Drop the jar for your version into .minecraft/mods/.

## Requirements

- Curios API (optional, loaded via reflection)
- Sophisticated Backpacks (optional, loaded via reflection)

## Features

- Repairs the most damaged item with the Mending enchantment every 2 ticks (server-side PlayerTickEvent)
- Up to 5 XP per repair, 2 durability per XP
- Scans inventory, armor, offhand, Curios slots, shulker boxes and backpacks
- XP bar is synced to the client after repairing

## Source Code

- https://github.com/Krypton0411/AutoMending (main = 1.20.1, forge-1.19.2 = 1.19.2, neoforge-1.21.1 = 1.21.1)
